caption: A photorealistic film still from a contemporary Chinese university romance short drama, cinematic live-action realism, square 1:1 image with 1024x1024 framing. Rich but natural skin texture, believable hands, fabrics and practical light, emotionally restrained acting, carefully staged subjects, no text, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Gu Xi is a 20-year-old Chinese female art student with long straight black hair, naturally expressive eyes, cream cardigan over white shirt and light blue jeans. Jiang Jin is a 22-year-old Chinese male computer science student with short neat black hair, charcoal jacket over white T-shirt, reserved face and a subtle old scar near his left wrist. Zhou Qian is a Chinese female student aged 21 with long wavy dark hair and powder blue outfit. H University digital art festival takes place in a real modern campus exhibition laboratory with a giant blue-violet LED display and realistic equipment. Late-night repair montage represented as a single frozen cinematic image: Gu Xi in the cream cardigan in the foreground working with a pen tablet to export blue-purple concept assets, Jiang Jin slightly behind using a laptop to correct the live interactive display. The broken blue-violet artwork fills the distant LED wall. Contrast of warm desk lamp and cool monitor lighting, both concentrated, clean square depth layering, no supernatural effects outside the display.
